label: training-qwen-first-resumed-forward-v1
resume_checkpoint: Checkpoint 20 from the continuous branch of this run.
primary_variable: Observe only the first matching-input native forward on ranks 2 and 6. Both branches retain the existing strict math-SDPA training policy.
output: All-rank native input/loss fingerprints and checkpoint contents comparison. Real text layers, mask counters, rank placement and final resource reclaim.
recovery_gate: Require both original step windows, all-rank policy and input receipts plus checkpoint comparisons. Native serialization hashes alone do not prove semantic restoration or cross-platform equivalence.
observational_effect: Full tensor hash materializes the recorded boundaries and can change host enqueue/synchronization timing. Matching a prior digest is not presumed.
